question: Where is the headquarters of the Badminton World Federation located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malaysia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badminton World Federation__**

 
 
• It is the international governing body for badminton recognized by the International Olympic Committee.
 
• It was founded in 1934 with nine member nations.
 
• Headquarters: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
• President: Poul- Erik Hoyer Larsen.
